title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. maritima
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. maritima, commonly known as Maritime Kidney Vetch or Sea Kidney Vetch, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The health benefits of Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. maritima are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues, and skin irritations, highlighting its potential as a natural remedy.
